_note: Body → field ties. basis: jung = Jung makes the link in the cited text (quote verified against the read-only corpus by `npm run sky:check`); inferred = the vault or the atlas infers it, justified in the note; site = editorial. readings.name: The Self as their coniunctio
readings.statement: Sol and Luna, joined: the coniunctio oppositorum, which Jung calls the form the alchemists gave to the union of opposites. Of the Self he writes that it is a union of conscious (masculine) and unconscious (feminine).

cites.quote: The coniunctio oppositorum engaged the speculations of the alchemists
Psychologically the self is a union of conscious (masculine) and unconscious (feminine)
